info.title: Minerva Calendar Sync API
info.description: Management API of the Minerva calendar sync agent: connected calendar accounts, synced calendars and events, availability and its overrides, sync history and event publishing.

calendarId.description: The provider's own calendar id this run synced

source.description: The source label this calendar's events are stored under

type.description: Whether this run re-fetched everything or applied a delta

calendarId.description: The provider's own calendar id this day's stats are for

source.description: The source label this calendar's events are stored under

runCount.description: How many sync attempts ran against this calendar this day

avgDurationMs.description: Mean run duration in milliseconds, across this day's runs

totalCount.description: Events processed, summed across this day's runs

eventId.description: The canonical event id (source:uid) this change applied to

calendarId.description: The provider's own calendar id this run synced

source.description: The source label this calendar's events are stored under

type.description: Whether this run re-fetched everything or applied a delta

recurrenceRule.description: The provider's own recurrence description (RRULE lines for Google, a serialized Graph recurrence pattern for Microsoft) — recorded for reference only, never parsed or expanded by this app

provider.description: Which CalendarProvider implementation this calendar uses

accountLabel.description: Which stored OAuth credential this calendar authorizes with

source.description: The source label written onto this calendar's event rows

synced.description: True once at least one full sync has completed

enablePush.description: Whether a provider push-notification channel is configured for this calendar

enabled.description: Whether this calendar's sync is turned on — a disabled calendar is skipped by polling, push, and manual sync alike

lastSyncedAt.description: When a full or incremental sync last completed for this calendar

syncing.description: True while a sync (from any trigger — poll, push, or manual) is in progress for this calendar

includedInBusy.description: Whether this calendar's events count toward the busy/free calculation (GET /freebusy, /freebusy/timeline) — off lets a calendar stay synced and visible without affecting computed availability, e.g. a shared holidays calendar

provider.description: Which provider this calendar's account authorizes with

accountLabel.description: Which stored OAuth credential this calendar authorizes with — must already be a connected account for this provider

calendarId.description: The provider's own calendar id, from GET /calendar-accounts/{accountLabel}/available-calendars?provider=...

source.description: The source label to write onto this calendar's event rows

enabled.description: Whether this calendar's sync should run

includedInBusy.description: Whether this calendar's events should count toward the busy/free calculation

enqueued.description: How many of this calendar's events were enqueued for redelivery to the outbound broker

truncated.description: True if this calendar has more non-deleted events than the backfill cap — only the most recent ones (by start time) were enqueued

accountLabel.description: The stored-credential label this status describes (see google-credential-store / microsoft-credential-store)

provider.description: Which provider this account authorizes with

sources.description: Source labels of the configured calendars that authorize with this account

status.description: Status of the device-flow OAuth credential backing this account's sync

scope.description: OAuth scopes granted the last time this account completed the login flow

obtainedAt.description: When the stored refresh token was obtained

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the access token minted from the most recent check — google-auth-library mints a fresh one automatically around this time whenever sync next runs, so this doubles as the 'next refresh' time.

error.description: Human-readable detail when status is 'expired' or 'error'

provider.description: Which provider to authorize a new account with

transactionId.description: Opaque id — poll GET /calendar-accounts/new/{transactionId} with this to learn the outcome

authUrl.description: Open this URL in a browser and sign in to authorize a new account

status.description: pending: waiting on the user to finish signing in. success: the account is connected — see accountLabel. error: the flow failed — see error.

accountLabel.description: The newly authorized account's label (its email address), once status is 'success'

authUrl.description: Open this URL in a browser and sign in to grant Minerva access again

id.description: The provider's own calendar id (e.g. "primary" or a shared calendar's id)

summary.description: The calendar's display name, as the provider shows it

alreadySynced.description: Whether this calendar is already configured to sync

source.description: The source label this row's stats are for

calendarId.description: The configured calendar this source belongs to, if it's still configured

oldestPendingAt.description: createdAt of the oldest still-pending row — a growing age is the signal something downstream is stuck

enabled.description: Whether outbound sync is configured at all (RABBITMQ_URL set)

eventId.description: The canonical event id (source:uid) this row describes

source.description: The source label this row's event belongs to

subject.description: Lifted from the row's payload for display

attempts.description: How many delivery attempts have been made

enabled.description: Whether outbound sync is configured at all (RABBITMQ_URL set)

latest.description: The most recent outbox row for this event, or null if it's never been queued (e.g. it predates outbound sync being enabled)
